2034-4094-5189.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4094-5189.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

4247-4871-6291.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

643-3899-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-3899-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3899-5541-5571--6.description:
Use Bazaar Trader to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1870-4873-5087-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1870-4873-5087-7329.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-4873-5087-7329.description:
Use Mind Transfer Protocol to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

1379-2919-3197-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2919-3197-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2363-5224-7692.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

967-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
967-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper and Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2908-3967-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-3967-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2056-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
1618-2056-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2056-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

64-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Warden of the Eye and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Warden of the Eye and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

38-1869-3839.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
The token Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Hero.
The nontoken Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Hero trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Hero token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-3991-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3967-3991-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1887-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1115-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-1115-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

821-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2033-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

997-2173-5220-6539.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1494-5437-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1496-4050-6742.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1496-4050-6742.description:
Cast Timeline Culler either from your hand or from your graveyard for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
When Timeline Culler enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 2 life. 
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeline Culler, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1496-4050-6742.notes: If Timeline Culler is in your hand, you can instead cast it normally and then cast it via its warp cost on each other iteration. This adds {B} to the mana needed but removes the life requirement.

2034-6005-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
2034-6005-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

252-2073-2829--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1978-2757-3430.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Voltaic Construct, untapping a basic land.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: mutated on top of or below Rootha

2634-3198-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
2634-3198-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the copy of Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
Resolve Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of Rootha.
When Lore Drakkis enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rude Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2634-3198-5259.notes: If this combo nets infinite mana, you can return other instants and/or sorceries instead.

64-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
64-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Warden of the Eye and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Warden of the Eye, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3358-4068-4881.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
3358-4068-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4276-6308.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
4276-6308.description:
Activate any number of lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1879-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5231-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5231-5490.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {R}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-2511-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2511-5523.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

513-1304-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to any legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
513-1304-4445.description:
Activate the legendary creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {3}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nature's Chosen, attaching it to the legendary creature.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping the legendary creature.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Nature's Chosen to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Leyline Immersion, attaching it to the legendary creature.
Repeat.

1874-2034-3490-4159.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1874-2034-3490-4159.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Ageless Entity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

4112-4242-4499-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

161-480-1349.description:
Move to your end step.
Athreos triggers, placing a coin counter on Skullbriar.
Sacrifice Gore Vassal to put a -1/-1 counter on Skullbriar.
Skullbriar dies to having 0 toughness.
Athreos triggers, returning Skullbriar to the battlefield.
Repeating steps 4-5.
